action.mutates: installs dconf-service if absent (the dconf writer a GNOME desktop has), creates the account p8testdesk, and as it runs four dconf writes (the three locked keys and one unlocked key) in a dbus-run-session (its own user database under ~/.config/dconf); the results go to /run/p8test-dconf/user.txt

outcomes.outcome: dconf-cli is installed and the dconf profile stacks the user database over the system database local
the system database sets idle-delay 300 (5 minutes), lock-enabled true and lock-delay 0, compiled by dconf update
a user cannot override the three locked keys, while a key the class does not lock stays writable
a GNOME session actually locking after 5 idle minutes

uncovered.why: needs a running GNOME session; the runner starts only a Plasma session (kubuntu), and the plan's node has no desktop
parameter variants (one set holds one fixture, the defaults); untested
